# SEO data in Sanity

Sanity holds every page's meta tags and JSON-LD facts. Site code only maps them to HTML.

| Layer | Document | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| Site | `seo-site` | Organization, robots.txt, 404 meta and defaults for every page type |
| Page | the page itself | Its title, description, image, dates, author and FAQ |
| Override | `seo-<page id>` | Optional. Anything one page needs to differ on |

SEO sits outside page documents, so publishing an old page draft cannot erase it.

## Adding a page

Publish it, then deploy. Nothing else is needed for `servicePage`, `featurePage`, `blogPost`, `legalPage`: the title, description, breadcrumb, structured data, FAQ markup, share image and sitemap entry come from the type's defaults and the page's own content. Add an override only to improve on them.

## What happens when data is wrong

| Problem | Result |
|---|---|
| Site-wide data (`seo-site`, business, social links) | The build stops. Pages rendered per request stay up with their own title and no JSON-LD |
| A page with no usable title or description | That page is noindex, has no JSON-LD and is not in the sitemap. Others are unaffected |
| A page with a missing, invalid or already used address | It is not published. Fixed pages always keep theirs; otherwise the older page does |
| A block too incomplete to render | It is left out. Others are unaffected |
| A page too broken to render at all | Its address shows the not-found page, noindex, not in the sitemap |
| No page of one kind renders (three or more tried) | The build stops, because that is a code fault. Preview builds also stop when every use of a block fails |
| A bad override or JSON-LD item | That value is skipped and the default is used. Others are unaffected |
| An FAQ not shown on the page with its answer right after it | It is left out of the markup |

Every problem is listed in the build log and by `npm run seo:check`, with how to fix it.

## Images

A page's image can be a Sanity image field, a `https://cdn.sanity.io/images/...` address pasted in a text field, or a path to a file in this repository. Sanity images need no code change or commit. A path with no file behind it is reported, and no image shows.

## Changing SEO data

1. Put complete documents in a JSON file: `{"seo-servicePage-local-seo": {"title": "..."}}`. Use `null` to delete an override.
2. `npm run seo:write -- file.json` checks the whole site and lists what would change. It writes nothing.
3. `npm run seo:write -- file.json --yes` writes it. It needs `SANITY_AUTH_TOKEN` and stops if someone changed a document meanwhile.
4. Redeploy. `/services`, `/integrations`, `/tools`, `/faqs`, `/contact` and `/blog` update without one.

Every list item needs a unique `_key`; JSON-LD items also need a `_type`. `metaTitle`, `seoDescription` and `siteTitle` no longer set meta tags.

## Site: `seo-site`

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `robotsTxt` | text | required; 20 to 8000 characters | The whole robots.txt file. One 'User-agent: *' group, no Crawl-delay, and a Sitemap line. Cloudflare can add its own rules in front. |
| `notFoundTitle` | string | required; 10 to 80 characters | Title of the 404 page. |
| `notFoundDescription` | text | required; 50 to 160 characters | Description of the 404 page. It is never indexed. |
| `organization` | object | required | Who runs the site. Address and phone come from Business in site settings, social profiles from Social links. |
| `organization.type` | string | required; one of: Organization, LocalBusiness, ProfessionalService | Organization unless customers can visit in person during listed hours. |
| `organization.name` | string | required; 2 to 80 characters | Public name. |
| `organization.legalName` | string | optional; up to 120 characters | Registered legal name. Leave empty if unsure. |
| `organization.description` | text | required; 50 to 300 characters | What the company does and for whom. |
| `organization.logo` | path | required | Logo path or https URL, at least 112x112. |
| `organization.email` | email | optional | Public contact email. |
| `organization.areaServed` | list | optional; up to 30 items | Places served. Only list places the page or business really covers. |
| `organization.areaServed[].type` | string | required; one of: State, AdministrativeArea, City | State, AdministrativeArea (a county) or City. |
| `organization.areaServed[].name` | string | required; up to 80 characters | Place name. Example: `Maryland` |
| `website` | object | required | The site itself. |
| `website.name` | string | required; 2 to 80 characters | Site name. |
| `website.language` | string | required; one of: en-US | Content language. |
| `defaults` | list | required; 1 to 60 items | What every page of each type gets with no setup. A new page works as soon as it is published. |

### Defaults: `seo-site.defaults[]`

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docType` | string | required; one of: home, aboutPage, servicesPage, servicePage, featurePage, integrationsPage, toolsPage, faqsPage, contactPage, blogPage, blogPost, legalPage | The page type these defaults apply to. Every type needs exactly one entry. |
| `title` | template | required; up to 120 characters | Title pattern. {title} is the page's own title. Example: `{title} | Maryland Insights` |
| `description` | template | required; up to 200 characters | Description pattern. {description} is the page's own description, cut at a sentence or word to fit 160 characters. Example: `{description}` |
| `jsonLd` | list | required; 1 to 10 items | Structured data every page of this type gets. Must include schemaWebPage. |

## Override: `seo-<page id>`

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | optional; 10 to 80 characters | The full browser-tab and search-result title, used exactly as written. Must be unique. Keep it to 60 characters: longer titles are reported, because search engines cut them. Leave empty to use the page type's template. Example: `Local SEO for Maryland Businesses | Maryland Insights` |
| `description` | text | optional; 50 to 160 characters | The search-result summary, in one or two plain sentences. Must be unique. This is not the visible intro. Leave empty to use the start of the page's own description. |
| `canonical` | url | optional | Leave empty. Fill only when this page duplicates another page here that should rank instead. |
| `noindex` | boolean | optional | On keeps the page out of search engines and the sitemap. Leave empty for normal pages. |
| `ogTitle` | string | optional; 10 to 90 characters | Title on shared links. Leave empty to use the title. |
| `ogDescription` | text | optional; 30 to 200 characters | Summary on shared links. Leave empty to use the description. |
| `ogImage` | path | optional | Share image, 1200x630: a site path or https URL. Leave empty to use the generated image. Example: `/images/share/local-seo.png` |
| `dateModified` | date | optional | The day the content last changed in a way a reader would notice. Used in structured data only; sitemap dates are automatic. Only for pages with no date of their own; a date on the page always wins. Never a future date. Example: `2026-10-14` |
| `jsonLd` | list | optional; up to 10 items | Changes to the page type's structured data. Add an item to change or switch off that item, or to add a schemaCustom. |

## JSON-LD items: `jsonLd[]`

In defaults, the fields marked below as needed must be set. In an override, set only what changes.

### `schemaWebPage`

Says what kind of page this is. Title, description and dates are filled in automatically. Needed: `pageType`.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageType` | string | optional; one of: WebPage, AboutPage, ContactPage, CollectionPage, ItemPage | WebPage for most pages, AboutPage, ContactPage, CollectionPage for lists, ItemPage for one item. |

### `schemaBreadcrumb`

The trail from the homepage to this page. This page is added to the end automatically. Needed: `parents`.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | optional | Off hides this item on this page. Leave empty for on. |
| `parents` | list | optional; up to 5 items | The pages above this one, in order, homepage first. Every path must be a real page. |
| `parents[].name` | string | required; up to 110 characters | Label. Example: `Services` |
| `parents[].path` | path | required | Site path starting with /. Example: `/services` |

### `schemaService`

A service this page sells. Name and description come from the page; the provider is always the organization. Needed: `serviceType`.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | optional | Off hides this item on this page. Leave empty for on. |
| `serviceType` | template | optional; up to 80 characters | Plain category. {title} uses the page's own title. Example: `Local search engine optimization` |
| `areaServed` | list | optional; up to 30 items | Leave empty to use the organization's areas. |
| `areaServed[].type` | string | required; one of: State, AdministrativeArea, City | State, AdministrativeArea (a county) or City. |
| `areaServed[].name` | string | required; up to 80 characters | Place name. Example: `Maryland` |

### `schemaArticle`

A blog post. Headline, image, author and dates come from the post. A byline matching the organization's name uses the organization; any other is a person.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | optional | Off hides this item on this page. Leave empty for on. |
| `image` | path | optional | Leave empty to use the post's main image. |

### `schemaFaq`

Marks up FAQ items found in the page's own content. Only questions and answers visible on the page are published, so nothing is typed here.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | optional | Off hides this item on this page. Leave empty for on. |

### `schemaCustom`

Any other schema.org item, as JSON. Use only when no type above fits. Describe only what visitors can see on the page. Needed: `label`, `json`.

| Field | Type | Rules | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | optional | Off hides this item on this page. Leave empty for on. |
| `label` | string | optional; 3 to 60 characters | What this is, for other editors. |
| `json` | json | optional; up to 5000 characters | One JSON object with an @type and no @context. No reviews or ratings of ourselves. Example: `{"@type":"VideoObject","name":"..."}` |

## Adding a kind of page or item

- **A new kind of page:** build its template with `seoId` on `Base`, add one line to `ROUTES`, and add its entry to `seo-site.defaults`. Tests fail if a page route is not in `ROUTES`; the build stops if a type has no defaults.
- **A new FAQ section design:** nothing. Any `faqItem` in the page is found.
- **A new JSON-LD type:** add it to `JSON_LD_ITEMS`, map it in `graph.mjs` and add a test. For a one-off, use `schemaCustom`.
